name: chenile-ecosystem
description: Generates a Chenile service ecosystem from the existing service and mini-monolith blueprints

inputFields.name: monolith
inputFields.description: Name of the primary mini monolith

inputFields.name: security
inputFields.description: Enable security in generated mini monoliths

inputFields.name: jpa
inputFields.description: Enable JPA in generated mini monoliths

inputFields.name: includeServiceRegistry
inputFields.description: Generate a separate service registry mini monolith and configure the primary monolith as its delegate

inputFields.name: serviceRegistryMonolith
inputFields.description: Name of the service registry mini monolith

inputFields.name: serviceRegistryUrl
inputFields.description: URL for the generated service registry

inputFields.name: includeCconfig
inputFields.description: Include the cconfig service in the primary mini monolith

inputFields.name: includeHeadlessService
inputFields.description: Generate a headless service and its mini monolith

inputFields.name: headlessMonolith
inputFields.description: Name of the headless-service mini monolith

inputFields.name: includeQueryService
inputFields.description: Generate a MyBatis query service and its mini monolith

inputFields.name: queryMonolith
inputFields.description: Name of the query-service mini monolith
